newsitem.title: ISRAEL: ECI gets orders from France Telecom.
newsitem.headline: ECI gets orders from France Telecom.

text.p: ECI Telecom Ltd in cooperation with Dassault Automatismes & Telecommuniations has been chosen by France Telecom as sole supplier of access network pair gain systems, ECI said on Wednesday.

ECI estimated the framework agreement, awarded for an initial period of three years, could reach $28 million. The Israeli company has already received $5 million in orders from France Telecom as part of the contract.
The systems will be used to expand and renew France Telecom's existing telecommunications infrastructure, enabling rapid deployment of increasing numbers of subscribers.

"Further levels of cooperation with our new partner ECI Telecom can be foreseen, especially in the field of access networks," Daniel Delpey, Dassault A.T.'s telecommunications division general manager, said in a statement.
